title: Metric
description: Defines what is measured and how measurement is performed within the system.

id.description: Globally unique identifier for this metric.

entityType.description: Entity type discriminator. Always "Metric" for Metric entities.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this metric record was last updated.

measurementWay.description: Way in which measurement is performed.

measurementType.description: Type of measurement defined by this metric.

compositionItems.description: Component metrics. Required for composite measurements; nonempty when supplied.

method.description: Method used to measure this metric.

applicableEntityIds.description: IDs of entities to which this metric applies, in EntityType/ID form.
